title: Concept: Cipher initialized with a zero-filled static IV in javascript — review required
description: In javascript, createCipheriv is given a zero-filled buffer as the IV. An IV exists to make each message under a key unique; a constant one restores deterministic encryption and exposes equal plaintext blocks across records. The pattern is easy to introduce because the code still runs and still produces ciphertext.
applicability: javascript services that encrypt stored fields or messages.
risk: Plaintext equality disclosure and keystream reuse; MEDIUM severity.
